normalization_addendum: Per-set mean log probabilities; duplicate query multiplicity does not weight a positive/negative set. This supersedes the draft logsumexp expression before any current A/B task labels.
same_information_direct_control: Linear preference kernel on frozen query/text interaction features with source log scores, ridge=1e-3 * mean feature-pair norm squared. A preference target residual=max(0,1-source pair logscore gap). No modified model weights.
